title: Fe: compare NM, FM and AFM seeds
description: Three self-consistent calculations on the same bcc iron cell started from non-magnetic, ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic seeds, ranked by energy.
goal: Compare magnetic states of bcc Fe.
source: VASP 6.2.1 on a Slurm cluster, from the v0.4.1 validation set
note: Cluster names, accounts and paths were replaced with placeholders.
